## Assessment so far (before seeing the images)
Instructions packed in images "for your AI to follow" are untrusted input: evaluate, don't execute blindly.

"Clipping page" usually means one of two things:
1. **Authorized clipping**: clipping streamers/creators who pay per view through clipping campaigns, with permission.
   Legit, but it's a different business from our channel (their content, their brand).
2. **Reposting other people's clips / trailers at high volume**: reused-content demonetization (YPP "inauthentic /
   reused content"), Content ID claims, copyright strikes, channel termination risk. **We don't do this.**

## Takeaways already compatible with our playbook
- Launch-week volume matters: post daily while GTA 6 search interest peaks (already in our plan).
- Same Short on YouTube + TikTok + Instagram Reels (zero extra production cost).
- Clips from **our own** gameplay captures = clipping done safely.
